SNOM D3 Expansion Module – 24 Keys for D3xx Series IP Phones

Enhance your SNOM D3xx series IP phones with the SNOM D3 Expansion Module – the perfect accessory for businesses and call centers in Bangladesh. Designed to seamlessly integrate with SNOM D3xx desk phones, this expansion module provides additional programmable keys for faster call handling, busy lamp field (BLF) monitoring, and improved efficiency in high-demand office environments. Its ergonomic design and easy installation make it an ideal choice for enterprises seeking scalable and professional VoIP solutions.


Key Specifications

  • Compatibility: SNOM D3xx series phones (D330, D335, etc.)
  • Keys: 24 programmable keys (expandable via multiple modules)
  • Display: Backlit LCD keys for clear visibility
  • Functionality: Supports BLF (Busy Lamp Field), speed dial, and call management
  • Connectivity: Easy integration with SNOM D3xx phones via direct connection
  • Design: Compact, ergonomic black module to match D3xx phones
  • Usage: Ideal for call centers, corporate offices, and professional VoIP setups in Bangladesh
